findings.title: Horizontal IDOR on Incident & Order Endpoints
findings.description: Certain query handlers perform entity lookups by identifier without strictly verifying that the authenticated user's organization owns the entity.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce organization-level tenant filters across all SQLModel queries and dependency injection checks.

findings.title: Hardcoded Fallback Secrets & Permissive JWT Lifetimes
findings.description: Default fallback strings for JWT signing keys in development configurations risk production deployment exposure if environment validation fails.
findings.remediation_plan: Fail-fast on service startup if JWT_SECRET_KEY is empty, unset, or equal to development defaults.

findings.title: SQLModel Parameterized Query Validation
findings.description: The service strictly utilizes SQLModel parameterized statements with typed Pydantic models. No raw string interpolation is present.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural mitigation maintained by ORM governance.

findings.title: Absence of Rate Limiting on Authentication Routes
findings.description: Lack of IP-based or account-based rate limiting on login and password reset routes permits brute-force credential stuffing.
findings.remediation_plan: Introduce Redis-backed sliding-window rate limiters on /api/v1/auth/login and /api/v1/auth/reset-password.

findings.title: Permissive CORS Wildcard with Credentials Enabled
findings.description: CORSMiddleware configured with allow_origins=['*'] alongside allow_credentials=True, permitting unauthorized cross-origin requests with session credentials.
findings.remediation_plan: Replace wildcard origins with explicit CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS environment variable loaded at startup.
findings.verification_proof: Verified by services/api/tests/unit/test_security_cors_configuration.py confirming rejection of untrusted origins with credentials.

findings.title: Unpinned Transitive Dependencies in pyproject.toml
findings.description: Some package dependencies specify loose lower bounds without upper bounds, leaving builds susceptible to upstream updates.
findings.remediation_plan: Lock lockfiles using uv lock and configure automated vulnerability scanning.

findings.title: Missing Refresh Token Rotation and Invalidation
findings.description: Access tokens cannot be revoked before natural expiration; no token revocation denylist is maintained.
findings.remediation_plan: Implement a Redis token denylist for instant logout and session revocation.

findings.title: Unsigned Webhook Payloads for External Ingestion
findings.description: Incoming telemetry payloads from external carriers are validated for schema but lack HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.
findings.remediation_plan: Introduce webhook signature verification headers for enterprise carrier endpoints.

findings.title: Sensitive Credentials & Raw Exception Traces in Logs
findings.description: Unhandled exceptions exposed raw internal details (str(e)) in HTTP responses, leaking database internals to clients.
findings.remediation_plan: Refactor FastAPI exception handlers to return sanitized error messages, and enforce regex-based secret redaction in logging.

findings.title: Outbound HTTP Webhook & Telemetry Client Dispatch
findings.description: Outbound HTTP requests are strictly limited to pre-configured carrier API endpoints and database clusters.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural absence of user-controlled target URIs.

findings.title: Client-Side Route Protection Bypass Risk
findings.description: Relying purely on client-side routing guards without server-side verification in Next.js middleware allows attackers to view UI shells.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce route protection and JWT claims validation in Next.js server-side middleware.ts before rendering protected pages.

findings.title: Plaintext Session Token Storage in LocalStorage
findings.description: Storing bearer JWTs in browser window.localStorage exposes tokens to extraction via potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
findings.remediation_plan: Migrate token storage to HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure cookies managed by backend endpoints.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Unsanitized Rich Text
findings.description: Rendering unescaped Markdown or incident summaries could allow DOM-based XSS if user-supplied carrier error messages contain malicious HTML.
findings.remediation_plan: Use DOMPurify on dynamic HTML rendering, or leverage standard React JSX text nodes which auto-escape by default.

findings.title: Absence of Client-Side CSRF Token Validation
findings.description: CSRF is mitigated because client applications interact with backend APIs via Authorization Bearer headers rather than ambient cookies.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural mitigation maintained.

findings.title: Missing Strict Content Security Policy & Security Headers
findings.description: Applications lack centralized security response headers: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.remediation_plan: Configure headers() in next.config.js across all Next.js applications to inject standard defense-in-depth security headers.

findings.title: Outdated Frontend npm Package Dependencies
findings.description: Transitive npm dependencies in React/Next.js client toolchains require periodic audit and updating to address known CVEs.
findings.remediation_plan: Run npm audit fix and integrate GitHub Dependabot security alerts for the npm workspace.

findings.title: Inadequate Client Session Inactivity Timeout
findings.description: Operations dashboard remains logged in indefinitely if tab remains open, violating session expiration best practices.
findings.remediation_plan: Implement a 30-minute client idle session timeout with modal prompt and automatic redirection to login.

findings.title: Missing Subresource Integrity (SRI) on External Assets
findings.description: The applications do not load dynamic scripts or stylesheets from third-party public CDNs; all client bundles are locally built.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural mitigation maintained.

findings.title: Verbose Console Logging of API Responses
findings.description: Certain development console.log statements output full API error structures, potentially exposing user identifiers in browser consoles.
findings.remediation_plan: Strip console.log statements in production builds via Babel or Next.js compiler removeConsole options.

findings.title: Next.js Server Action / Route Handler URL Rewrites
findings.description: Frontend applications do not expose proxy endpoints or Server Actions that accept arbitrary URLs to fetch on behalf of users.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural absence of open reverse proxying.

findings.title: Tool-Level IDOR on Cross-Customer Orders & Brand Metrics
findings.description: When the autonomous agent calls operational tools, tool parameters were passed without validating that caller session context owns the order or brand.
findings.remediation_plan: Implement validate_tool_authorization(session_context, tool_name, parameters) enforcing fail-closed access denial.

findings.title: Carrier API Credentials & Tokens Exposed in Tool Logs
findings.description: Carrier credentials (UPS, FedEx, DHL, MRW, SEUR) and customer tokens risked exposure in trace telemetry without regex redaction.
findings.remediation_plan: Introduce regex-based carrier credential masking and sensitive parameter sanitization in GuardrailObservabilityService.
findings.verification_proof: Verified by services/api/tests/unit/test_guardrail_observability_redaction.py demonstrating 100% redaction of carrier credentials.

findings.title: Direct & Indirect Prompt Injection via RAG Knowledge Chunks
findings.description: Adversarial prompt injection payloads could attempt to manipulate LLM reasoning or override instructions via retrieved context.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce multi-layer input guardrails, encapsulate retrieved RAG context in XML tags, and maintain strict system prompt boundaries.

findings.title: Excessive Agency in High-Value Returns & Carrier Reassignment
findings.description: Autonomous approval of returns with refund value > 100 EUR or changing carriers for parcels already IN_TRANSIT represents unacceptable risk.
findings.remediation_plan: Implement AgentActionPoliciesService enforcing programmatic human-in-the-loop (HITL) authorization gates.

findings.title: Unbounded Token Generation Limits on LLM Nodes
findings.description: LLM generation parameters without explicit max-token bounds or temperature caps risk denial-of-wallet (DoW) attacks via recursive loops.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce max_tokens=1024, temperature=0.2, and timeout bounds on all LLM calls.

findings.title: Agent Framework & MCP Adapter Dependency Risks
findings.description: Fast-evolving LLM ecosystem libraries (langgraph, fastmcp, qdrant-client) require pinned versions to prevent unvetted parser vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation_plan: Pin exact versions in lockfiles and audit changelogs during upgrades.

findings.title: Missing Session Binding in Agent WebSocket Handshake
findings.description: Support agent WebSocket endpoints require robust token validation during the handshake to prevent unauthenticated session initiation.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce Depends(get_current_user) or ticket bearer token validation on WebSocket connection acceptance.

findings.title: Knowledge Base Context Poisoning via Unsigned Ingestion
findings.description: If administrative document upload endpoints lack cryptographic integrity checks, malicious actors could poison the Qdrant return policy knowledge base.
findings.remediation_plan: Enforce role-based access control and document checksum validation on knowledge base ingestion.

findings.title: Inadequate PII Redaction in Multi-Turn Agent Traces
findings.description: Agent conversation traces may capture customer names, shipping addresses, phone numbers, and IBANs, creating privacy compliance risks.
findings.remediation_plan: Integrate automated PII masking across all persisted agent checkpoints and traces.

findings.title: Outbound Tool Network Dispatch to External Targets
findings.description: Agent tools do not perform dynamic network fetching or accept target URLs from LLM generation.
findings.remediation_plan: Architectural absence of unconstrained outbound network tools.
